title: Shift Outdoor Walks to Early Afternoon
appliesWhen: Winter smog season when early morning AQI is in Poor or Severe bands

sources.title: Diurnal variations of surface PM2.5 in Delhi NCR
sources.organisation: IITM SAFAR / Ministry of Earth Sciences

effectModel: Avoids 40–60% higher surface particulate exposure caused by overnight thermal inversion traps between 6 AM and 9 AM.

title: Substitute Outdoor Physical Education with Indoor Activities
appliesWhen: CPCB NAQI >= 201 (Poor, Very Poor, or Severe)

sources.title: Health effects of physical exertion in polluted air among school children

effectModel: Children inhale 2–3 times more air per unit body weight during heavy exertion; moving PE indoors avoids acute bronchospasm.

title: Work From Home During GRAP Stage III/IV Smog Alerts

sources.title: Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP) for Delhi-NCR

effectModel: Eliminates commuter road transit exposure and reduces city traffic congestion by ~15%.

title: Stagger Commute to Avoid Peak Traffic Inversion Hours
appliesWhen: Daily road commute during November–January smog months

sources.title: Commuter exposure in urban transit environments
sources.organisation: Centre for Science and Environment (CSE India)

effectModel: Traveling after 10 AM avoids stagnant vehicular tailpipe plumes trapped by early morning boundary layer compression.

title: Pre-Filter Bedroom Air 30 Minutes Before Sleeping

sources.title: Residential air filtration and nocturnal cardiopulmonary biomarkers
sources.organisation: American Journal of Respiratory and Critical Care Medicine

effectModel: Reduces nocturnal inhaled particulate dose by 75–85%, improving sleep architecture and morning blood pressure.

title: Gentle Isotonic Saline Rinse After High-Smog Exposure
appliesWhen: Unavoidable outdoor exposure in Very Poor or Severe air

sources.title: Saline nasal irrigation in allergic rhinitis and particulate clearance

effectModel: Mechanically flushes coarse particles and inflammatory mediators from upper nasal mucosa without chemical side effects.

title: Maintain Adequate Daily Hydration for Mucociliary Escalator

sources.title: Airway surface liquid regulation and mucociliary clearance

effectModel: Prevents dehydration of respiratory tract mucus, supporting natural bronchial particle expulsion.

title: Turn Off Vehicle Engines in School Zones
appliesWhen: Parent and carpool school pick-up / drop-off zones

sources.title: Idle reduction campaigns at school zones and local particulate concentrations
sources.organisation: US EPA Clean School Bus Program

effectModel: Cuts localized toxic ground-level benzene, NOx, and PM2.5 concentrations at school gates by up to 30%.

title: Ensure Window Latches and Weather Stripping Are Engaged Overnight

sources.title: Infiltration of ambient PM2.5 into residential buildings

effectModel: Reduces infiltration air exchange rate from 0.8 h⁻¹ to 0.35 h⁻¹, halving nighttime indoor particulate penetration.

title: Replace Morning Jog with Indoor Yoga / Resistance Bands for Seniors

sources.title: Exercise in air pollution and cardiovascular risk in older adults

effectModel: Avoids exercise-induced vasoconstriction and blood pressure spikes associated with exercising in cold, particulate-dense morning air.
